title: fix(plugin-list): spec bare-string sort form crashed ListView (#2578 shape-mismatch audit)
body:
## Summary

Deliverable of the spec↔objectui **shape-mismatch audit** that followed the dashboard filter-options crash (#2597): a systematic sweep of every place the renderer consumes an authored shape narrower than what `@objectstack/spec` allows. One real bug found and fixed; everything else verified safe.

## The bug

`ListViewSchema.sort` in the spec is `string | Array<{ field, order }>` — the **top-level bare-string form** (`sort: "name desc"`) is valid authored metadata, and `@object-ui/types` already declared the union. But `ListView` called `schema.sort.map(...)` (a string has `.length > 0`, so the guard passed) → **"schema.sort.map is not a function"**, crashing the list.

Sort parsing is now a single normalized `parseSortConfig` (exported, unit-tested): bare string, legacy `"field desc"` array entries, and `{ field, order }` objects all parse; malformed entries drop instead of throwing. Also deduplicates the parser that was copy-pasted between the state initializer and the schema-sync effect.

## Audit scope + everything verified safe

Two-sided sweep: cataloged every author-facing spec shape (options arrays, string|object unions, label fields), then checked each objectui consumer.

- **Label-as-object crash class does not exist**: spec `I18nLabelSchema` is plain `z.string()` at runtime (the record-form `I18nObjectSchema` is referenced by nothing) — so raw `{label}` renders in ReportViewer / SelectField / FilterUI / chart label maps are safe by construction.
- **string|object unions all normalize** with `typeof` guards at their consumers: gantt `quickFilters.options` + `tooltipFields`, `lookupColumns`, `dependsOn` (core `resolveDependsOnFields` + LookupField), `record-highlights` fields, list `columns`, `compareTo`.
- **Object-only options shapes** (`FieldSchema.options`, `ActionParamSchema.options` — spec allows no string shorthand there): consumers assume objects, which is spec-correct; per the contract-first rule no lenient string fallback was added.

## Testing

- 3 new unit tests for `parseSortConfig` (bare-string form, mixed arrays, malformed input); `pnpm vitest run packages/plugin-list` — 160 passing.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list` build clean. Changeset: patch.

Refs #2578, #2597, framework#2501
